title: Air Status
description: Unsolicited air-to-ground report of the air unit's own health, forwarded to any connected GUI viewer. Sent on connect and whenever a reported value changes; ground caches the latest one and replays it to a viewer that attaches later. `battery` is omitted when the air device cannot report it. `dataUsage` carries cumulative WebRTC payload bytes for the session (across peer-connection restarts); the GUI derives the current rate from successive samples.
